```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6, 9.5),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

# https://dr.homechoicebristol.co.uk/Data/Pub/PublicWebsite/ImageLibrary/HomeChoice%20Bristol%20Information%20Sheet%2018-19%20-%20Jan%202019.docx
# https://services.bristol.gov.uk/files/documents/10032-homechoice-bristol-information-sheet-07-24/file
lettings_2013_2024 = {
'FY': ['2013-14', '2014-15', '2015-16', '2016-17', '2017-18',
       '2019-20', '2020-21', '2021-22', '2022-23', '2023-24'],
 'Bristol City Council ': [1532, 1329, 1363, 1445, 1301,
                           1402, 1138, 1065, 1030, 970],
 'Housing Association ': [652, 700, 633, 603, 514, 480, 441, 391, 494, 565],
 'Total': [2184, 2029, 1996, 2048, 1815, 1882, 1579, 1456, 1524, 1535]
}
source_df = pd.DataFrame(lettings_2013_2024).set_index("FY")
source_df.loc["2018-19"] = pd.NA
source_df.loc["2024-25"] = pd.NA
source_df = source_df.sort_index().reset_index()

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
```

## Social housing lettings

### All years

```{python}
import seaborn.objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches
df = source_df
wrap_width = 13
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
fig_title = "Social housing lettings in Bristol (all sizes)"
fig.suptitle(fig_title)
p = (so.Plot(df, x="FY", y="Total")
     .add(so.Dots(fillalpha=0.7, alpha=1.0, pointsize=6, stroke=1.5))
     .add(so.Line(linewidth=2.5))
     .add(so.Line(linewidth=2.5, linestyle=(4, 2), color=".6"), so.PolyFit(1))
     .label(x="", y="")
     .limit(y=(0, 2300), x=(-0.5, 11.35))
     .theme({"xtick.bottom": True, "xtick.labelsize": "small", "ytick.labelsize": "small"})
     .on(fig)
     .plot()
     )
fig.axes[0].tick_params(axis="x", length=7.5, pad=1.75)
i = 0
for x in fig.axes[0].get_xticklabels():
    x.set_verticalalignment("top")
    x.set_horizontalalignment("right")
    x.set_rotation(30)
    x.set_rotation_mode("anchor")
    if i < 4:
        x.set_color(".6")
    i+=1
for x in fig.axes[0].get_xticklines()[0:8]:
    x.set_color(".6")
    x.set_markeredgecolor(".6")

plt.tight_layout()
rect = patches.Rectangle((3.75, 50), 7.5, 2200, linewidth=2, edgecolor=".6", facecolor="none")
fig.axes[0].add_patch(rect)
rect = patches.Rectangle((-0.5, 0), 4.25 , 2300, linewidth=2, edgecolor="none", facecolor=".8", alpha=0.5, zorder=2)
fig.axes[0].add_patch(rect)
plt.text(11.1, 100, "Bristol SH research period", color=".5", ha="right")
fig.savefig(assets_output + "Figure_10.1.svg")
plt.show(block=False)
```
